faq.titulo: Instant Answers to All Your Questions
faq.desc: Everything you need to know about our home LPG gas delivery service with digital scale in Lima.
faq.q1: How do I know the cylinder is 100% full?
faq.a1: Our delivery driver weighs the cylinder on a calibrated digital scale in front of your door before installation in your kitchen.
faq.a2: No, delivery and technical safety installation with zero-leak testing are completely free in Surquillo, Miraflores, San Borja, and San Isidro.
faq.q3: How long does delivery take to my home?
faq.a3: Estimated delivery time is 12 to 20 minutes dispatching from our central hub at Jr. Dante 260, Surquillo to any of the 4 covered districts.
faq.q4: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a4: We accept Cash, Yape, Plin, and all credit or debit cards through our delivery driver's wireless POS terminal.
faq.q5: What should I do if I smell gas in my kitchen?
faq.a5: Immediately close the regulator valve knob, open windows to ventilate the area, and call our Emergency SOS Line right away at 936 369 384.
faq.q6: Are you officially authorized by OSINERGMIN and what is your code?
faq.a6: Yes, Solgas Surquillo is an officially authorized distributor registered with OSINERGMIN under Registration No. 208492. All our cylinders feature the official factory security seal from Solgas S.A., digital scale weight verification at your door, and strict compliance with Peruvian safety regulations.
